description: Zoom verbs on the browser a window shows: the message pane, or the page of the front tab. The script loads when the first verb is called.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Answers the zoom level of the window's browser, 1 for 100%, or null when the front tab has nothing to zoom (calendar, tasks, a mail tab with no message).

functions.name: set
functions.description: Sets the zoom level of the window's browser. Answers false, with nothing done, when the front tab has nothing to zoom.
